user.description: Choose the Fluval light to add.

abort.already_configured: This light is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Fluval light found. Make sure it is in range and the Fluval app is not connected to it.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a Fluval Connect light.

init.description: The light allows one Bluetooth connection at a time. Holding it open keeps commands fast, but stops the Fluval phone app from connecting.

data_description.keep_connected: Turn this off to share the light with the phone app. Commands then get slower, because each one has to connect first.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to read the light's state. Defaults to 60 seconds while the connection is held, 300 when it is not, since every refresh on a shared link costs a fresh connect.

set_simple_schedule.name: Set simple schedule
set_simple_schedule.description: Write a Pro schedule for an ordinary day: dark, ramp up to the given levels, hold, ramp back down. Replaces the existing Pro schedule.

on_at.name: Lights on
on_at.description: When the light starts coming up.

off_at.name: Lights off
off_at.description: When the light finishes going down.

color.name: Colour
color.description: The red/green/blue mix, picked the same way as on the light itself.

white.name: White
white.description: Level of the dedicated white channel.

ramp_minutes.name: Ramp
ramp_minutes.description: How long the sunrise and sunset fades take.

set_pro_schedule.name: Set Pro schedule
set_pro_schedule.description: Replace the light's Pro schedule. The light ramps between consecutive points, so each one is a breakpoint rather than a scene.

points.name: Points
points.description: One row per breakpoint: a time and the mix to reach at it. In YAML you can give "levels" instead of a colour for exact channel percentages.

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: Replay the whole Auto or Pro day compressed into the given number of seconds.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long the replay should take.
